notes: Rules frozen before replay; no parameter sweep or winner selection.
Only completed candles are visible; earliest entry is next 4h opening.
Net target uses initial isolated margin and actual accumulated funding, not account equity.
Both directions use symmetric trend/breakout rules; no averaging down or pyramiding.
Conservative one-hour stop-first execution; exact intrabar order, historical order book, historical margin tiers and event-calendar coverage are unavailable.
Current fee and maintenance assumptions require venue confirmation before execution; this candidate cannot submit live orders.
Use conservative 0.10% taker fee per side uniformly; current Aster fee documentation classifies SKHYNIX separately from the lower RWA fee group.
Current public Aster tier for notional below 1,000,000 USDT has 1.5% maintenance margin and permits up to 50x; historical tier changes are unavailable. Stress at 5% maintenance margin.
Evaluation is retrospective chronological replay, not a new unseen or forward-tested sample.

stock_entry_rules.control: 1h EMA20/50/200 breakout of prior20-hour extrema, rising/falling mid EMA; 60% net initial-margin target.
stock_entry_rules.trend_volume: Same breakout plus most recent CLOSED 4h EMA20/50/200 ordering, mid/slow slopes over6 bars; closed hour volume >=1.25x median prior20 active hours (>=5); >=4 of last6 hours active.
stock_entry_rules.retest: Same trend/volume at setup and confirmation; within next1..6 closed hours retest boundary wick in [-0.5,+0.25] setup ATR directional distance, close on breakout side within1ATR and beyond prior hour extreme. Current 1h trend also agrees; consume each setup once.

external_rules.price_only: Exact prior control, no external admission.
external_rules.nq_confirmation: Most recent available NQ hourly EMA20>EMA50 with rising EMA50 over6 observations and positive6-observation return for longs; mirror for shorts.
external_rules.nq_sector_risk_confirmation: Require NQ, ES and SOX agreeing with stock signal. VIX<=25 and latest3-observation rise<=10%. Longs vetoed if dollar6-observation return>0.2% AND yield10 relative6-observation rise>0.5%; both trade directions retained.

declaration.availability: Every five-minute ENTRY RETRY checks external data at its own timestamp, using only rows with provider open +1h +20min <= retry time. Not signal-close-only filtering.
declaration.missing_or_stale_policy: Block affected external overlay; no proxy substitution or neutral imputation.
declaration.evaluation_policy: Development before Sep1; validation Sep1..Sep20; recent Sep20..snapshot cutoff; full is overlapping diagnostic. All THREE declared arms evaluated, no tuning, ranking or later-window fallback. Require EACH chronological window and EACH cost to pass.
declaration.qualification_gate: Minimum samples 30 development/10 validation/10 recent/50 full; net win rate>=70%, actual net60 success rate>=70%, no winning trade below net60, positive closed and estimated net liquidation PnL, DD<=6%, no liquidation. 70% actual net60 success is a stronger joint-outcome criterion, reported separately from ordinary win rate.
limitations: Newest historical external vintage and assumed20min publication delay are not exact historical first-seen records.
NQ/ES front-contract rolls and source revisions are not reconstructed; no NQ trade-return claim.
Six external factors can overlap; a same-direction vote is not an independent probability estimate.
Original stock execution/funding/index proxies and zero-volume fill limitations retained.
Every arm and time window is declared; no tuning or selecting a later-window winner.
declaration.deployment: No retrospective result changes active admission. Prospective unseen validation is still required.
